content.content: 1. Necessity: abandonment needs the remove verb for abandoning only when nothing depends on it — without it, abandoning is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Abandonment is where the elaboration meets the remove verb; the gate keeps the use sound without testing removal itself.
